tasks.description: Stop lisinopril; start losartan 50 mg once daily. Send new prescription.
Basic metabolic panel (kidney function, potassium) after switching to losartan.

summaryEn.greeting: Hi Rosa, thank you for coming in today. Here is what we talked about.

whatWeDiscussed.explanation: Your blood pressure today was 138 over 88. That is better than last time. Your home readings are mostly in the 130s.
Your dry cough is likely a side effect of lisinopril. Changing your medicine should help it go away.

medicationChanges.name: Losartan 50 mg
medicationChanges.instructions: Take 1 pill (50 mg) once a day.

nextSteps.text: Get a blood test to check your kidneys and potassium.
Come back to check your blood pressure.
